comments.mergedPostDetails: It would be nice if we could save avatars that we have currently equipped. Logging out then back in will let you keep your previous avatar, so what about completely saving them to the avatar menu? Obviously if the creator marks the world as private or removes the avatar, you would then be unable to use it, but it would be nice to not have to go all the way to a world just for one avatar and then back again.

When we choose an avatar that we like, we'd like to stay in that avatar. However, when we need to change to another avatar due to a specific world we will need to return to that avatar world ( that might be deleted or hard to find) and grab the same avatar. Please give us a save avatar button
So we don't have to keep a list in our heads or go running to some random world every time we login to change our skin.
